description: Session documents and the verdict of each whole Load: Python's load_session
A vector applies its edits (JSON Pointer; set or remove) to a copy of its base. python is
accept or refuse, with pythonMessage, a fragment of Python's refusal. web is loaded,
repaired (webRepairs: the code@path of each repair, listed or not) or refused (webClass:
R1-R4, the refusal classes of the Load repair receipt; the Web's diagnostic names the
S1: a vector Python accepts is not refused by the Web, unless difference names its open
finding. S2: a refusal has a class. S3: a vector Python accepts and the Web repairs lists
only repairs of webOnlyRepairs ({code, path, finding}: what the Web repairs and Python
A vector whose id starts with row- takes its base out of one row of
describe_session_admission(); every row has one that Python refuses and the Web refuses
or repairs. A vector the Web loads with no row may leave a row only with a value that
holds nothing (null, [], {}) at an optional field (rule 1, E-OD06), or with a retired
top-level home (config, features) of a mode-scoped Session (E-OD03).
